title: Born–Haber cycle
basic_overview: Hess-law cycle connects formation enthalpy to atomisation, ionisation, electron gain and lattice formation.

extra_info_content.short_trick: Write every step and sign before algebra.
extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. Sublime/atomise metal. 2. Atomise nonmetal. 3. Ionise metal. 4. Add electrons. 5. Assemble lattice. 6. Sum to ΔHf°.
extra_info_content.factors: Lattice-energy sign conventions differ; define whether lattice formation or separation is used.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
